claim: The Louvre's headline 2026 show 'Michelangelo and Rodin: Living Bodies' runs April 15–July 20, 2026 in the Hall Napoléon, with 'Martin Schongauer: The Beautiful Immortal' (April 8–July 20) and 'Primeval Waters: Lessons from Mesopotamia' (May 20, 2026–March 15, 2027).
quote: Michelangelo and Rodin: Living Bodies — Dates: April 15 – July 20, 2026 — Location: Hall Napoléon ... Martin Schongauer: The Beautiful Immortal — Dates: April 8 – July 20, 2026 ... Primeval Waters: Lessons from Mesopotamia — Dates: May 20, 2026 – March 15, 2027

claim: The Louvre Michelangelo/Rodin exhibition brings together over 200 works (marbles, bronzes, plasters, drawings) in collaboration with the Musée Rodin, structured in five sections, the first time the two sculptors' works are shown together.
quote: Two unrivalled masters of Western sculpture engage in a dialogue across the centuries: Michelangelo and Rodin, with their works brought together for the first time ... over 200 works, including marbles, bronzes, plasters, and drawings

claim: Musée d'Orsay shows 'Renoir and Love' (March 17–July 19, 2026) and 'Mary Cassatt: The Choice of Independence' (Oct 6, 2026–Jan 31, 2027); the Grand Palais hosts Nan Goldin (Mar 18–Jun 21), Hilma af Klint (May 6–Aug 30), Leandro Erlich (Jun 2–Sep 6) and 'Cézanne and Us' (Sep 23, 2026–Jan 17, 2027).
quote: Renoir and Love (March 17 - July 19, 2026) ... Mary Cassatt: The Choice of Independence (October 6 - January 31, 2027) ... Hilma af Klint (May 6 - August 30, 2026) ... Cézanne and Us (September 23 - January 17, 2027)

claim: The Centre Pompidou's Beaubourg building closed 22 September 2025; the major renovation begins early 2026 and runs to 2030, with its big exhibitions (Matisse 1941–1954, Hilma af Klint) hosted at the Grand Palais and a new Centre Pompidou Francilien in Massy opening spring 2027.
quote: will close its doors on 22 September 2025 ... The major renovation project...will begin in early 2026 and is expected to conclude by 2030 ... Grand Palais (Paris): Hosting exhibitions including 'Matisse. 1941–1954' and 'Hilma af Klint' in 2026

claim: The Grand Palais 'Matisse 1941–1954' (March 24–July 26, 2026) features more than 230 works including the Blue Nudes, drawing on the Pompidou collection while that museum is closed.
quote: Matisse 1941-1954 at the Grand Palais runs from March 24 to July 26, and features more than 230 paintings, drawings, books and Cut Outs, including works from Paris' Pompidou centre and international collections like the Blue Nudes

claim: The Fondation Louis Vuitton's flagship 2026 show is 'Calder: Rêver en Équilibre' / 'Dreaming in Equilibrium' (April 15–August 16, 2026), a near-300-work Alexander Calder retrospective marking the centenary of his arrival in Paris, followed by 'Gustave Fayet' (Oct 9, 2026–Mar 8, 2027).
quote: Calder. Dreaming in Equilibrium (April 15 - August 16, 2026) - Nearly 300 works including mobiles and sculptures ... Gustave Fayet (October 9, 2026 - March 8, 2027)

claim: The Musée Jacquemart-André shows 'Splendeurs du Baroque / Baroque Splendors' (March 26–August 2, 2026), some 40 Hispanic Baroque works including Velázquez, El Greco and Zurbarán with the Hispanic Society of America, followed by 'Eternal Tintoretto' (Sep 11, 2026–Jan 24, 2027).
quote: The exhibition runs from March 26 to August 2, 2026 ... 'Splendeurs du Baroque' (Baroque Splendors), showcasing Hispanic Baroque art in collaboration with the Hispanic Society of America (New York), featuring some forty works including paintings by Velázquez, El Greco, and Zurbarán

claim: The Musée de l'Orangerie presents 'Henri Rousseau, The Ambition of Painting' (March 25–July 20, 2026) and later 'Monet and Time' (Sep 30, 2026–Mar 29, 2027) exploring the water lilies series.
quote: 'Henri Rousseau, The Ambition of Painting' runs from March 25th to July 20th, 2026 ... Monet and Time (September 30, 2026 - March 29, 2027) - Exploring moments and water lilies series

claim: The Musée du Luxembourg presents 'La ligne Warhol / The Warhol Line' (September 16, 2026–January 10, 2027), focused on Andy Warhol's drawings and lesser-known works.
quote: The exhibition 'La ligne Warhol' runs from September 16, 2026 to January 10, 2027 ... The Warhol Line ... Andy Warhol's sketches and forgotten works
